notes: Add animations for your characters here. The key must match a character 'id' from characters.json.
Each character can define clips for these states: run, attack, skill, death. Any you omit fall back (death/skill -> run/attack), and characters with NO sprites just use the emoji look.
State meanings: run = marching, attack = fighting in place, skill = playing while its special fires, death = played once when it dies.
Two ways to define a clip:
Options: fps (frames per second, default 10), loop (default true; death defaults to false so it stops on the last frame).
'facesRight': false at the character level if your art faces left (it is flipped automatically per side).
Drop your image files anywhere reachable by the page (assets/ is provided). Then reload — no code changes needed.
The 'ranger' below uses the generated placeholder art in assets/ranger/ (see tools/gen_sample_sprites.mjs). Replace those files, or add new character ids, with your own art.
